text: S7 wrapper. baseline returns whatever kruskal_wallis_cpp() returns, unwrapped, plain list statistic, df, p_value. Unlike x_by(), path return class_kw_test. print method (tibble H Statistic, Degrees Freedom, p-value columns) registered statim::making_tidy() entry (tibble::as_tibble(.x@data)), rather inheriting statim::auto_tidy() class_kw_test.

title: Kruskal-Wallis Test: Grouped (x_by) — kwtest-xby
text: "pairwise" Runs default Kruskal-Wallis test, pairwise group comparisons using rank-based z-test tie correction. Accepts one additional argument: p_adj_method P-value adjustment method pairwise comparisons, passed stats::p.adjust(). Must one stats::p.adjust.methods. Default "holm". Requires least two groups; errors otherwise.

title: Kruskal-Wallis Test: Grouped (x_by) — kwtest-xby
text: default, returns class_kw_test object. pairwise variant returns plain list (kw_test, comps) registered print method — return class_kw_test, inherit statim::auto_tidy() automatically. statim::making_tidy() registered separately pairwise path via .x@data$comps.

title: Kruskal-Wallis Test: Grouped (x_by) — kwtest-xby
